mcp:tool-listener.name: list_opportunities
mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: Tool: list_opportunities
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Lists sales opportunities, optionally filtered by name (substring match), priority (High/Medium/Low), highPriorityOnly, and/or exact stageName. Returns the full opportunity records as a JSON array.

mcp:tool-listener.name: update_opportunity
mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: Tool: update_opportunity
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Updates one or more fields (amount, stageName, priority, probability, closeDate, nextStep) on an existing opportunity identified by oppId. Fields not provided are left unchanged. Fails if the oppId does not exist.

mcp:tool-listener.name: close_opportunity
mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: Tool: close_opportunity
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Closes an opportunity identified by oppId, marking it Closed Won or Closed Lost. Automatically sets probability (100 for Won, 0 for Lost) and stamps closeDate as today. Fails if stageName is not 'Closed Won'/'Closed Lost' or if the oppId does not exist.

choice.doc:name: Route: Invalid, Not Found, or Closed
